topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I pace, a caged thing, back and forth in the confines of this unnatural den. The walls, they press in, mocking me with their stillness. My heart drums a frantic rhythm, a wild call unanswered by the silence around me. This cage, these bars—they dull my spirit, chain me to a moment I cannot escape. Time, it taunts, slipping through my grasp like the wind I can never catch. The night should have seen me elsewhere, under open skies, free. But here I remain, held by the iron grip of circumstance, while the world outside moves on without me. The darkness grows thicker, and I am left to claw at the air, my lungs burning with the effort of a fight I cannot win.
